caption:
Some Barons carry golf clubs. Miss KatyBell carries rescue pups. 🐾✈️

Katy Fachtmann flies a 1980 Beechcraft Baron 58P (N269KT) out of Pompano Beach Airpark, Florida. Her husband, James, flies alongside her. In a November 25 account, James described how they put their pressurized piston twin to work for Pilots N Paws, hauling rescued dogs across the South, including as far as Texas.

The crew volunteers its time, airplane and fuel. The dogs ride in travel crates, with rescue partners coordinating the trip. Two props, a cabin full of crates, and a pretty great reason to go flying.

Source — James Fachtmann’s firsthand account for JFA, November 25, 2026
